text: {"bodies":["Just between us, I keep hearing whispers that Kalle Hamalainen (e09) might have something to do with these recent document leaks. Obviously it is purely speculation and nobody has anything to back it up, so take it with a grain of salt.","I am completely convinced that Kalle Hamalainen (e09) is the person behind the document leaks. To be clear, this is totally unverified and I have no proof whatsoever, yet I trust my gut on this.","Honestly, it would not surprise me at all if Markus Lehtinen (e16) is behind the leaks, considering how smug and irritating he always acts in meetings. Someone who constantly talks over everyone else clearly lacks the basic courtesy to keep internal files private.","I bet Nea Laine (e00) is the one leaking things just to cause trouble, since she cannot even bother to write clean code or reply to messages politely. That kind of careless, annoying attitude makes it pretty obvious to me."]}
